title: Planned dockers' meeting at the Labour Exchange about BEU/employer conditions
reason: The planned agenda addressed port employer conduct and workers' private workplace conditions; no source confirms that this scheduled meeting occurred as a gathering. The verified Dec 30 public courthouse mobilization after the union president's arrest is separately recorded as BEN2024-12-E001.
notes: Do not code the scheduled meeting as an occurred protest or conflate it with the strike/courthouse crowd. Search-result and contemporaneous accounts say the meeting was planned; the arrest changed the day’s action.
